title: The Great Cookie Mystery! 🍪
description: Someone ate the LAST cookie! The pencil family turns detective 🕵️🍪 #kids #cartoon #pencilfamily

beats.text: My cookies! The last cookie is GONE!
beats.action: The pink mom pencil walks up to the kitchen counter, lifts the lid of a big cookie jar, peeks inside, and gasps dramatically - the jar is completely empty. She holds the jar upside down and one tiny crumb falls out.

beats.text: Nobody move! This is a cookie mystery.
beats.action: The blue dad pencil with glasses marches into the kitchen, takes the empty cookie jar, and inspects it closely like a detective examining evidence, adjusting his glasses and stroking his chin.

beats.text: Wasn't me. I only eat likes.
beats.action: The teal teenager pencil with purple glasses slides into the kitchen staring at her pink phone, shrugs without looking up from the screen, and leans against the counter.

beats.text: I didn't eat the cookie! Promise promise PROMISE!
beats.action: A small energetic kid pencil bounces into the kitchen jumping up and down, waving both arms wildly in denial, shaking his head very fast.

beats.text: Look look! Crumbs go that way!
beats.action: The tiny baby pencil toddles into the kitchen giggling, then excitedly points down at a trail of cookie crumbs on the kitchen floor leading out of the room.
The blue dad pencil kneels down on the kitchen floor, discovers the trail of cookie crumbs, points forward heroically, and starts tiptoeing along the trail.

beats.text: Shhh... the trail ends right here!
beats.action: The whole pencil family tiptoes in a sneaky line across a cozy living room, following cookie crumbs on the floor that lead behind a big comfy couch. The dad pencil in front holds a finger to his lips.
A cute orange puppy pencil slowly peeks out from behind the couch with cookie crumbs all over his face, ears drooping, caught red-handed, waving one paw shyly.

beats.text: Biscuit! Crumbs are ALL over your face!
beats.action: The pink mom pencil puts her hands on her hips looking at the guilty puppy pencil, tries to look stern, but slowly starts to smile.

beats.text: The cookie was lonely... so I helped it!
beats.action: The orange puppy pencil looks down at the floor with big sad puppy eyes, tail drooping, drawing a little circle on the floor with his paw, then looks up hopefully.

beats.text: Come here, you silly cookie monster!
beats.action: The whole pencil family bursts out laughing and rushes in for a big warm group hug around the little puppy pencil, lifting him up in the air.

beats.text: Fresh cookies for EVERYONE! Even you, Biscuit!
beats.action: The pink mom pencil walks in carrying a tray of fresh warm cookies, the whole pencil family jumps and cheers with joy, and the puppy pencil catches a cookie happily. Confetti-like sparkles in the air.
